# Front Desk Telephone Triage & Message Protocol
Juniper Family Medicine - Operational Guide

## Provider and Staff Directory
| Name | Role | Extension | Primary Responsibility |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Dmitri Sandoval, MD | Lead Physician | Ext. 4102 | Complex care, adult medicine, urgent consults |
| Colleen Sato, RN | Triage Nurse | Ext. 4108 | Clinical advice, acute symptom triage, labs |
| Grace Kowalczyk, CMA | Medical Assistant | Ext. 4114 | Prescription refills, vitals, pre-authorizations |
| Billing Department | Central Billing | Ext. 4130 | Claims, statement balances, insurance verification |

## Routing Instructions by Call Type
- Prescription Refill Requests: Route directly to Grace Kowalczyk, CMA. Inquire whether the pharmacy has already transmitted an electronic request.
- Acute Symptom Inquiries: Direct callers reporting shortness of breath, new rash, or worsening fever directly to Dmitri Sandoval, MD for immediate nursing assessment.
- Billing and Insurance: Direct all billing questions to Central Billing, unless related to an ongoing workers' compensation claim.
- Emergency Calls: For symptoms of chest pain, stroke, or severe hemorrhaging, advise the patient to hang up and call 911 immediately.

## Documentation Requirements for Messages
Every clinical message logged in the electronic health record must include caller identity, date and time of call, callback number, and the assigned provider inbox.

## After-Hours Protocol
Inform callers that after 5:00 PM, urgent issues should be directed to the on-call physician answering service at (555) 019-4822.
